projects.title: Autonomous RoboDog
projects.desc: A security quadruped that detects and follows a recognised face in real time using on-board computer vision.
projects.highlight: Basis of the IEEE NQComp-2026 research paper (MIT Manipal).

projects.title: Interactive Humanoid
projects.desc: An interactive humanoid that listens, understands and replies with real-time, lip-synced speech.
projects.highlight: Real-time speech recognition with lip-synced response.

projects.title: Smart Switch — LEO
projects.desc: A local-first smart-home switch and hub with its own MQTT broker, web dashboard and a companion Android app. Runs entirely on your network — no cloud.
projects.highlight: Fully offline — its own broker, mDNS clustering and a glassmorphic app.

projects.title: Smart Tank Monitor — AquaNode
projects.desc: A Wi-Fi water-tank monitor — ultrasonic level sensing, a live dashboard, colour LED status and push alerts, with on-device logging.
projects.highlight: Live dashboard updated in real time over Server-Sent Events.

projects.title: AI-Driven Smart Traffic Management
projects.desc: A computer-vision system that detects traffic flow and optimises signal timing to ease congestion.

projects.title: WALL-E Build
projects.desc: A WALL-E–inspired animatronic build with motion and personality, presented at the Innovative Project Expo.

projects.title: Path Finder Bot
projects.desc: An obstacle-avoiding robot that works out a route around barriers in real time.

projects.title: Line Follower Bot
projects.desc: An autonomous robot that follows a marked track using IR sensors and a tuned control loop.

projects.title: Smart Traffic System
projects.desc: A model traffic-control system that adapts signal timing to live road conditions using sensors.

projects.title: WLED Sign Board
projects.desc: A programmable LED sign board built for the campus Maker Space, with addressable lighting effects.

projects.title: Cyber Attack Demonstration
projects.desc: An educational demonstration of common attack techniques and their defences, built to teach safe security practices.

skillDefs.Python: My main language for AI, computer vision and scripting — from model code to the glue logic running on edge devices.
skillDefs.C: Low-level systems and microcontroller work, where tight control over memory and timing matters.
skillDefs.C++: Performance-critical logic and embedded firmware, including Arduino and robotics control loops.
skillDefs.Java: Object-oriented application development and my go-to for data-structures & algorithms practice.
skillDefs.Kotlin: Native Android development — the companion app for my Smart Switch (LEO) hub.
skillDefs.JavaScript: Interactive web front-ends and the live dashboards for my IoT projects.
skillDefs.React.js: Component-based dashboards and UIs — including the live AquaNode tank monitor and this portfolio.
skillDefs.Node.js: Server-side JavaScript for APIs and real-time backends.
skillDefs.Flask: Lightweight Python web services and REST endpoints for ML demos.
skillDefs.Bootstrap: Responsive layout scaffolding for putting web UIs together quickly.
skillDefs.REST APIs: Designing and consuming HTTP APIs to connect devices, services and front-ends.
skillDefs.HTML/CSS: Hand-built, responsive interfaces with a strong eye for layout and motion.
skillDefs.ROS 2: Robot middleware for control, messaging and simulation — which I teach to MakerSpace members.
skillDefs.Arduino: Rapid microcontroller prototyping for motors, sensors and robotics builds.
skillDefs.ESP32 (C3/S3): Wi-Fi/BLE microcontrollers at the heart of my smart-home and sensor nodes.
skillDefs.Raspberry Pi: On-board Linux compute for the vision and speech in my robots.
skillDefs.Jetson Nano: GPU edge computing for running ML models directly on-device.
skillDefs.FreeRTOS: Real-time task scheduling on microcontrollers for responsive, reliable firmware.
skillDefs.PlatformIO: Embedded build and dependency tooling across multiple boards.
skillDefs.MQTT: Lightweight pub/sub messaging — the backbone of my local-first smart-home hub.
skillDefs.Ubuntu: My primary Linux environment for development and robotics.
skillDefs.TensorFlow: Building and training neural networks for classification and detection tasks.
skillDefs.PyTorch: Deep-learning experiments and quick model prototyping.
skillDefs.OpenCV: Real-time computer vision — face detection, tracking and image processing in my robots.
skillDefs.Scikit-learn: Classical ML models, pipelines and evaluation.
skillDefs.NumPy: Numerical computing and array math underpinning my ML work.
skillDefs.Whisper AI: On-device speech recognition powering my interactive humanoid.
skillDefs.Leadership: I lead robotics builds at the MakerSpace and co-organise hackathons and expos — keeping teams aligned and moving toward a working result.
skillDefs.Agile: I work in short, iterative cycles — build, test, refine — to ship dependable prototypes quickly.
skillDefs.Mentorship: I have mentored 50+ members on programming, debugging and ROS 2, helping them go from an idea to a working build.
skillDefs.Problem-Solving: I enjoy breaking hard, ambiguous problems into solvable pieces — especially where hardware meets software.
skillDefs.Team Collaboration: I thrive in hands-on, collaborative settings where ideas are shared freely and challenges are tackled together.
skillDefs.English (India): Professional working proficiency — my primary language for documentation, presentations and collaboration.
skillDefs.Hindi: Fluent — comfortable in both everyday and professional conversation.
